items.imgPrompt: A slightly scuffed, matte black motorcycle helmet with subtle silver accents, resting on a wooden floor near a wall, showing minor scratches on the visor.

desc.zh: 当年跟着我拿了五连冠的宝贝，上面还有我亲手签的名，现在退役了，留着占地方，便宜卖给有缘人吧。
desc.zh_cn: 当年跟着我拿了五连冠的宝贝，上面还有我亲手签的名，现在退役了，留着占地方，便宜卖给有缘人吧。
desc.en: My championship helmet from the five-peat, signed by yours truly. Taking up space now, so it's yours for a steal.

items.imgPrompt: A tarnished silver skull pendant necklace, lying on a dark grey fabric surface, with visible wear on the edges and chain.

desc.zh: 以前出门常戴的，现在有了更好的，这个就闲置了。链子有点旧，但骷髅头还是那么酷，懂的来。
desc.zh_cn: 以前出门常戴的，现在有了更好的，这个就闲置了。链子有点旧，但骷髅头还是那么酷，懂的来。
desc.en: Used to wear this all the time, got a newer one. Chain's a bit worn, but the skull's still cool. For those who get it.

items.imgPrompt: A set of seven polyhedral dice in deep blue with white numbers, in a small velvet pouch, appearing almost new.

desc.zh: 陪我度过一些无聊夜晚的宝贝，现在很少玩了，希望它能给下一个人带来好运，就像它曾经给我一样。
desc.zh_cn: 陪我度过一些无聊夜晚的宝贝，现在很少玩了，希望它能给下一个人带来好运，就像它曾经给我一样。
desc.en: These dice saw me through some boring nights. Don't play much anymore. Hope they bring you as much luck as they did me.

items.imgPrompt: A sleek, black ceramic coffee mug with a subtle, almost invisible scratch near the handle, sitting on a kitchen counter.

desc.zh: 当初特意定制的，结果发现我还是喜欢直接喝，这个杯子就一直放着了。小划痕不影响使用，真心想要就拿走。
desc.zh_cn: 当初特意定制的，结果发现我还是喜欢直接喝，这个杯子就一直放着了。小划痕不影响使用，真心想要就拿走。
desc.en: Got this custom-made, but turns out I prefer drinking straight from the can. It's just been sitting there. Minor scratch, still works fine. Take it if you really want it.

items.imgPrompt: A well-worn, black leather wristband with a few scuffs and faded stitching, resting on a plain wooden surface.

desc.zh: 以前偶尔会戴，现在觉得有点太张扬了。有点旧了，但皮子还挺结实，随便戴戴吧。
desc.zh_cn: 以前偶尔会戴，现在觉得有点太张扬了。有点旧了，但皮子还挺结实，随便戴戴吧。
desc.en: Wore this sometimes back in the day, a bit too showy for me now. It's a bit old, but the leather's still solid. Just wear it, whatever.
